page.title: Commission rules
page.description: Platform, dealer, and product-type commission rates. When more than one rule could apply to an order, the most specific scope wins (dealer + product type, then dealer default, then platform default); within the same scope the rule with the latest effective-from date wins. Deactivating a rule only affects orders assigned from today onward — it never changes the commission already frozen on an existing order.

rules.bpsHelp: Rates are entered in basis points (bps): 100 bps = 1%, and the maximum is 10,000 bps (100%). A commission amount is always rounded to the nearest paise: amount = round(order subtotal in paise × rate bps ÷ 10,000).

table.title: Rules
table.empty: No commission rules yet. Create one to set a platform, dealer, or product-type rate.

confirmDeactivate.title: Deactivate commission rule
confirmDeactivate.text: This stops the rule from applying to any order assigned from today onward. It never changes the frozen rate on orders already assigned — commission snapshots are immutable.

errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to view commission rules.

fields.dealer.help: Leave empty to create a platform-wide default that applies to every dealer with no more specific rule.
fields.productType.help: Optional. Scopes the rule to one product type for the selected dealer. Requires a dealer — a product-type rule cannot apply to "all dealers".
fields.effectiveFrom.help: The rule applies to orders assigned on or after this date. When more than one rule in the same scope could match, the one with the latest effective-from date wins.

errors.unreachableScope: A product-type rule needs a dealer selected — it can never match "all dealers". Either pick a dealer, or clear the product type.

preview.rateBody: {{bps}} — on an example ₹10,000 order subtotal, that is a {{example}} commission.
preview.rateEmpty: Enter a rate between 1 and 10,000 bps to see the equivalent percentage and an example commission amount.
preview.unreachableWarning: A product-type rule with no dealer selected can never win: the commission engine only checks product-type rules for a specific dealer, never for "all dealers". Either pick a dealer, or clear the product type to create a platform-wide default.
preview.overlapTitle: Existing rules for this exact scope
preview.overlapNone: No existing rule matches this exact dealer + product-type combination yet.
preview.overlapHint: There is no server-side overlap guard. The new rule you are creating will win over these only once its effective-from date is the latest among matching rules as of a given order's assignment date.

dealerHistory.title: Commission history
dealerHistory.description: Every commission snapshot ever frozen for this dealer's assigned orders, newest first. Each row is immutable: it shows exactly the rate and amount recorded at assignment time, even if the underlying rule has since been edited or deactivated.
dealerHistory.immutabilityNotice: These rows never change after the fact. Deactivating or editing a commission rule only affects orders assigned from that point onward — it cannot rewrite a snapshot already recorded here.

pageTotal.label: Commission total (this page only)
pageTotal.hint: Sums only the rows currently shown — there is no lifetime-total endpoint for commissions.

table.title: Commission snapshots
table.empty: No commission has been recorded for this dealer yet.

error.dealerNotFound: Dealer not found or not approved

picker.title: Dealer commission history
picker.description: Pick a dealer to see every commission snapshot ever frozen for their orders — the recorded rate and amount never changes once an order is assigned, even if the rule is later edited or deactivated.
picker.searchPlaceholder: Search by business name or email

orderTab.immutableNotice: This is the rate and amount frozen when the order was assigned to this dealer. It never changes afterward — even if the commission rule that produced it is later edited or deactivated.
orderTab.noRuleHint: No commission rule matched this dealer/product type at assignment time — the commission was recorded as 0.

empty.title: No commission recorded
empty.description: This order has not been assigned to a dealer, or no commission snapshot exists for it yet. A snapshot is created automatically the moment an order is assigned to a dealer.
